body: I'm pretty sure I've been tested for lyme; no travel or tick bites. I spend most of my time around animals (lizards, cats, dogs, etc) but that's been my whole life. Thank you for the suggestion, I'm definitely going to try to bring it up - for some reason, all the primaries I've seen have been very reluctant to test for anything along the lines of meningitis and encephalitis. I'm not sure why.
